title: Mind the Gaps: Mixture-of-Minds for Human Simulation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the signed prediction error in semantic scale positions on ordinal survey questions to detect systematic skewing towards positive or sycophantic responses.

Comparing the demographic composition (age, gender, income, location, marital status, and merchant size) of the overall modeled population against the 50 lowest-scoring clusters to ensure poor performance is not concentrated in specific marginalized or demographic groups.
